segments.sn24.36:1.2: “Kismiṃ nu kho, bhikkhave, sati, kiṃ upādāya, kiṃ abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati –
segments.sn24.36:1.3: ‘neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’”ti?
segments.sn24.36:1.4: Bhagavaṃmūlakā no, bhante, dhammā … pe …“rūpe kho, bhikkhave, sati, rūpaṃ upādāya, rūpaṃ abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati –
segments.sn24.36:2.2: ‘neva hoti, na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’ti.
segments.sn24.36:2.3: Vedanāya sati … saññāya sati … saṅkhāresu sati … viññāṇe sati, viññāṇaṃ upādāya, viññāṇaṃ abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati –
segments.sn24.36:2.7: ‘neva hoti, na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’”ti.
segments.sn24.36:3.1: “Taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, rūpaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā”ti?
segments.sn24.36:3.3: “Aniccaṃ, bhante”… pe … vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, api nu taṃ anupādāya evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjeyya –
segments.sn24.36:3.5: ‘neva hoti, na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’”ti?
segments.sn24.36:3.7: “Iti kho, bhikkhave, dukkhe sati, dukkhaṃ upādāya, dukkhaṃ abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati –
segments.sn24.36:3.8: ‘neva hoti, na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’”ti.
segments.sn24.36:3.9: “Vedanā … saññā … saṅkhārā … viññāṇaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā”ti?
segments.sn24.36:3.13: “Aniccaṃ, bhante”… pe … vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, api nu taṃ anupādāya evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjeyya –
segments.sn24.36:3.15: ‘neva hoti, na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’”ti?
segments.sn24.36:3.17: “Iti kho, bhikkhave, dukkhe sati, dukkhaṃ upādāya dukkhaṃ abhinivissa evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajjati –
segments.sn24.36:3.18: ‘neva hoti, na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’”ti.
